statements.status_notes: Same module and commit as the prior statement (commit a139cc423184 from 2025-01-23, which postdates the v1.0.1 fix); refreshing for the current scanner PURL format that bakes the submodule path into the module name rather than emitting it as a subpath qualifier. The specs-go module contains only Go type definitions and constants from the OCI distribution spec; CVE-2021-41190 concerns content-type validation that was fixed in the specification itself, and zot implements its own conformant content-type validation as an OCI registry.
